description: Castle Textile Industries v. Deputy Commissioner of Labour Castle Textile Industries v. Deputy Commissioner of Labour View More before Hon. P.R. Walgama, J
parties: Castle Textile Industries v. Deputy Commissioner of Labour Castle Textile Industries v. Deputy Commissioner of Labour View More
keywords: Employees’ Provident Fund – Employer’s liability to contribute – Recovery certificate – EPF contributions and surcharge – Admission of liability – Payment by instalments – Subsequent default – Challenge to sufficiency of particulars in certificate – Employee names and remuneration – Requirement to adequately identify employees – Material prejudice – Employer having admitted liability cannot belatedly challenge certificate on appeal – Revision before Provincial High Court – Appeal dismissed with Rs. 10,000 costs. L.T.B. Dehideniya J. agreed.
legistation: Employees’ Provident Fund Act No. 15 of 1958 – sections 38(1) and 38(2), as amended by Act No. 8 of 1971; High Court of the Provinces (Special Provisions) Act No. 19 of 1990.
